what: Booz Allen Hamilton is a consulting firm that works almost entirely for the American government: defence, intelligence and civil agencies, increasingly on technology, cyber and AI programmes.
customers: The Department of Defense, intelligence agencies and federal civilian departments.
moat: Tens of thousands of staff with security clearances already embedded in agency programmes. Clearances take months to obtain and cannot be hired quickly by a competitor.
risks: Revenue fell from $12.0B to $11.2B as federal efficiency reviews cut consulting spending
Government consulting has been a specific target of spending cuts
opportunities: 12.8 times earnings and 10 times free cash flow with $984M of free cash flow
Clearance-holding staff remain scarce whatever happens to consulting budgets
The shift toward its own AI and cyber products earns better margins than billed hours
watch: Book-to-bill ratio and headcount, which together show whether demand is returning.
